info.flavor: Makaptan's blackwash wranglers are known for their bravado, but there are those notorious few who actively cultivate a menacing aura. These self-styled "reapers" flaunt their mastery over nanites by wielding them in combat, and many moonlight as mercenaries in addition to their usual wrangling gigs. The psychological threat of being consumed by greywash is by itself often enough to erode even the most experienced pilot's composure.
info.tactics: Reapers are melee defenders that use their signature debuff, Frightened, to force nearby enemies to pay attention to them or suffer debilitating effects. Though strong against stationary and grouped opponents, Reapers are slow for their short range and benefit from allies that provide reliable damage, mobility, and ways to deal with long-range attackers.
info.terse: Melee defender that forces nearby enemies to focus on itself or suffer delibitating control effects.

actions.name: Sow
actions.detail:
A character within Sensors must pass a Systems save or become Frightened.
Frightened characters make all attacks with +1 Difficulty, and when they take damage, the closest character allied to them that is within line of sight and Range 5 and not already Frightened must pass a Systems save or become Frightened.
Characters clear Frightened by passing a Systems save as a quick action or by damaging a Reaper.

add_special.detail: You make all attacks with +1 Difficulty. When you take damage, the closest allied character within line of sight and Range 5 who is not already Frightened must pass a Systems save or become Frightened.

name: Reap
effect: The Reaper chooses one of the following effects. Regardless of line of sight, all Frightened characters within Sensors clear Frightened, then suffer the Reaper's chosen effect.

actions.name: Fight
actions.detail: Targets take {2/3/4} Burn, plus additional Burn equal to the number of targets.

actions.name: Flight
actions.detail: Targets move 5 spaces in directions of the Reaper's choice. This movement is involuntary but provokes reactions and engagement as normal and doesn't count as pushing or pulling.

name: Malaise
effect: Frightened characters within the Reaper's Sensors exude a Burst 3 aura. While they are at least partially within the aura, other hostile characters make all checks and saves with +1 Difficulty. The effects from overlapping auras stack.

active_effects.name: Malaise
active_effects.detail: Frightened characters within your Sensors exude a Burst 3 aura. While they are at least partially within the aura, other hostile characters make all checks and saves with +1 Difficulty. The effects from overlapping auras stack.

actions.name: Morbid Curiosity
actions.detail: You spike your weapons with hypnotic memetics. The next time you make a successful ranged or melee attack, before it deals damage, all hostile characters within Range 5 of the target are pulled 3 spaces towards the target.

active_effects.name: Morbid Curiosity
active_effects.detail: The next time you make a successful ranged or melee attack, before it deals damage, all hostile characters within Range 5 of the target are pulled 3 spaces towards the target.

actions.name: Blight
actions.detail: Blight a free Blast 1 area within Sensors. Hostile characters that start their turn at least partially within the blighted area or move at least partially into it for the first time in a round become Frightened. If they are already Frightened, they take {2/3/4} Burn. The area lasts until you take this action again or this system is destroyed.

name: Overwhelming Presence
effect: The Reaper gains two additional options for Reap.

actions.name: Freeze
actions.detail: Targets are knocked Prone. If they are already Prone, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Fawn
actions.detail: Targets become Shredded and deal half damage, Burn, and Heat with attacks until the end of their next turn.

add_special.detail: You deal half damage, Burn, and Heat with attacks.

actions.name: Cascading Fear
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a Frightened character within Sensors. On a hit, the next time they take damage while Frightened, all of their allies within line of sight and Range 5 take {2/3/4} Burn, then must pass a Systems save or become Frightened. As long as the target is Frightened, this effect refreshes at the start of each round.

add_special.detail: The first time each round you take damage while Frightened, all allies within line of sight and Range 5 take {2/3/4} Burn, then must pass a Systems save against the Reaper or become Frightened.

name: Executioner [Veteran]
effect: 1/round, when the Reaper makes a successful attack with the Greywash Scythe, it may use that weapon to attack a different character within Threat, dealing half damage and Burn.
